description: This file defines the StorageInterface interface for configuration storage in Drupal, including method signatures for reading, writing, deleting, renaming, encoding, decoding, and managing configuration collections.

classes.name: StorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for configuration storage operations in Drupal.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration object exists.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads configuration data for a given object.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes configuration data into storage format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes configuration data from storage format.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration object names with optional prefix.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes configuration objects with names starting with a prefix.
